responsibility: This file provides the MIPS-specific target hooks needed by the D front end. It registers D builtin version identifiers that describe the selected MIPS word size, ABI, and floating-point ABI, and it implements target-info handling for __traits(getTargetInfo, ...) queries such as "floatAbi", converting backend state like TARGET_64BIT, mips_abi, and hard/soft-float mode into the D frontend’s compile-time target metadata.
